newsitem.title: CROATIA: PRESS DIGEST - Croatian weekly Nacional - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Croatian weekly Nacional - Aug 19.

text.p: Following are highlight of the leading stories in Croatian weekly Nacional. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Croatia sends Pero Skopljak to The Hague to delay extradition of Ivica Rajic and Dario Kordic. Skopljak, a former commander of the Bosnian Croat police in Vitez, was arrested in Samobor and is in custody of the Zagreb County court.

- German car firms plan to open assembly lines in Croatia, following a meeting between Foreign Ministers Mate Granic and Klaus Kinkel at the weeked. The meeting may have been spurred by Italy taking over from Germany as Croatia's leading export partner in June.

- Dobroslav Paraga, head of the ultranationalist Party of Rights 1861, says 20 Bosnian Croat officials paved the way for ethnic cleansing in Bosnia in 1991. Nacional also publishes the text of Paraga's charges against President Franjo Tudjman, Defence Minister Gojko Susak and several Bosnian Croats filed to the Hague war crimes tribunal. -- Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075
